notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing "e" multiple times while getting out of bed would mess up the player's height.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could put down the flashlight during the animation, causing the light to turn on while the flashlight isn't held and visa versa.
[/list]

[b]UI Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Changed the main menu to be a live view of the living room, rather than a gif.
[*] Updated the font on various text events.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Changed the difficulties from 'normal' and 'hard' to 'story' and 'challenge'
[*] Added two new endings to story mode.
[*] Added candles for the player to collect each night in order to get the good ending.
[*] Changed 'Night 6' to 'Final Night' on story mode.
[*] Added new cinematics to the new endings.
[*] Added an extras menu.
[*] Added a cheats and challenges menu that unlocks after the player completes either ending. Cheats and challenges are only usable in challenge mode.
[*] Added stats that the game tracks for the player.
[*] Added new anomalies.
[*] Added new animations to The Shadow Stalker.
[*] Made it to where the player can toggle the flashlight on and off.
[*] Made it to where the game automatically advances to the next night after each completion rather than going to the menu.
[*] Rebalanced difficulty.
[*] Added multiple non-lethal jumpscares.
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Created a scrolling credits screen.
[*] Added new soundtrack "Living Nightmare" to the good ending night.
[*] Added text informing the player that save data was erased when they press 'yes' 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Gameplay changes

[list]
[*] Made it to where dying in normal mode no longer erases your save data. Save data is still erased when dying in hard mode.
[*] Added a tutorial text on night 1 for searching for an fixing anomalies. 
[*] Added text on night 1 reminding the player to pick up the flashlight.
[/list]

Visual Changes

[list]
[*] Added segment about data erasing in hard mode description on difficulty selection screen.
[*] Changed copyright notice on main menu to use "© instead of "copyright"
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed anchoring on the background blur in the pause menu.

[*] Fixed an issue where closing the game and reopening it would desync the night number and nigths survived number.

[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Release
notes.notes:
Adjusted the speed of the sleep bar.

Sleep bar now progresses slightly slower in normal difficulty.

Sleep bar now progresses slightly faster in hard difficulty.

notes.title: Note Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the note widget would not close properly after the player interacts with it.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]

- Removed tutorial level
- Added gameplay instructions to night 1
- Made it to where the player cannot pick up a log if the fire is full

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed the note in storage not closing when TAB is pressed.
- Fixed painting in kitchen being "fixed" when interacted with when not anomalous
